timing_and_knowledge.known: Phase5 envelope bounds and registered metadata only; design review identified common K may be dominated by rate extrapolation.

content.reason: One common count threshold mixes 35 normally-silent indicators with 36 load-sensitive shared rate/count columns; held-out load extrapolation can raise K and suppress small indicator violations.
content.change_type: add secondary analysis; original primary envelope and H1-H5 remain unchanged

secondary_detector.name: envelope_dual_count_secondary
secondary_detector.partition_rule: indicator=envelope minus raw IF/envelope overlap; rate_shared=the 36 raw columns in both envelope and IF; lists frozen here
secondary_detector.folds: same GroupKFold(config_id,n_splits=4,shuffle=False); refit preprocessing and bounds on fold-train only
secondary_detector.calibration: For each judgeable held-out row compute strict counts k_ind and k_rate. K_ind=max k_ind and K_rate=max k_rate pooled across four held-out folds. Stop if a fold has no judgeable row; no fallback.
secondary_detector.final_fit: refit bounds on all 472 normal rows; keep held-out K_ind/K_rate in Phase6 model artifact
secondary_detector.judgeable: true only when all 71 selected values are finite; otherwise unknown under original policy
secondary_detector.alarm: strict (k_ind > K_ind) OR (k_rate > K_rate); equality is no alarm
secondary_detector.metrics: same prereg masks, unknown accounting, FPR breakdown, delay and bootstrap; report beside primary, never select by test result

content.interpretation: If primary misses admin_down and this secondary catches it, report a calibration-family interaction; do not replace primary or rewrite H1.
content.deviation_policy: This artifact is immutable after commit. Further change requires a numbered amendment.
